description: Source code for a Zephyr-based Modbus TCP gateway application, implementing network socket handling, Modbus protocol processing, and logging.

methods.name: init_backend_iface
methods.description: Initializes the Modbus backend interface by obtaining the interface index and setting up the client.

methods.name: modbus_tcp_reply
methods.description: Sends a Modbus ADU response over TCP to the client.

methods.name: modbus_tcp_connection
methods.description: Handles a single Modbus TCP connection, receiving request, processing, and replying.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up the TCP server, accepts incoming connections, and manages communication loop.
